The Chinese characters for Kelly

As a transliteration, Kelly is usually written 凯莉 (Kǎi lì). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

凯
Kǎi
triumphant, victorious
莉
lì

Origin and meaning

With Irish origins, Kelly is usually read as “warrior, bright-headed”.

About the name Kelly

An Irish surname meaning 'warrior', popular for any gender in the 1970s.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Kelly carries the meaning “warrior, bright-headed” and looks striking in brush strokes.
